questionnaire.choice_text: Creating digital artwork for a game

art_style.reference: Match src/assets/1.1.png and 1.2.png — unDraw-style full-body edu characters
art_style.fill: solid flat color blocks with minimal cel shade
art_style.mood: playful creative-studio energy — approachable digital art hobby, not a corporate game-dev office

riasec_accent.use: color swatch fan, stylus grip band, smock pocket trim

riasec_secondary.use: sprite character outline glow, hair streak

color.background: transparent — faint grey decorative circles allowed at 15% opacity

character.hair: short undercut with a pastel lavender-dyed top
character.face: minimal — two dot eyes, small smile, no detailed nose
character.diversity_note: unique cast per slot — androgynous presentation distinct from 1.1 and 1.2 references

pose.stance: full body, standing three-quarter toward a large upright drawing tablet easel
pose.action: shading a small winged creature sprite on the easel screen with a stylus, other hand holding a fanned color-swatch card

top.detail: charcoal front pocket, gold pocket trim, worn over a light grey tee

subject.choice_label: Creating digital artwork for a game
subject.scene_narrative: A young artist stands before a large upright drawing tablet easel, mid-stroke shading the wing of a small winged creature sprite that is half line-art and half colored, a fanned color-swatch card held in the free hand — a full-body flat vector scene echoing the playful maker energy of the approved references.
subject.hero_prop: large upright drawing tablet easel with a lavender-tinted screen showing a half-colored winged creature sprite
supporting_props: small pencil sketch sheet clipped to the easel edge
subject.environment: thin grey floor line only, two faint grey decorative circles behind figure — no studio interior

composition.layout: figure left-of-center, easel prop right, balanced like 1.1.png
composition.thumbnail_test: silhouette of person + easel readable at 160px

generation.negative_prompt: face photograph, realistic skin pores, text, watermark, letter A, UI chrome, border frame, sticker card, top-down POV hands only, white background fill, photorealistic, 3d render, cropped head, extra limbs

prompt_for_image_ai: Flat vector full-body illustration, 640x640, transparent PNG background. Style MUST match KursoKo reference assets 1.1.png and 1.2.png: unDraw-inspired edu character, thin 2px dark outline #2D2D2D, flat color fills, minimal dot-eye face. Androgynous college-age person, tan skin, short undercut hair with a pastel lavender-dyed top, purple #4B2C7F cropped smock overshirt with a charcoal pocket and gold #FFD54F trim over a light grey tee, charcoal wide-leg cropped pants and canvas high-tops. They stand before a large upright drawing tablet easel with a lavender-tinted screen showing a small winged creature sprite half line-art and half colored in sky-blue, shading its wing with a stylus that has a gold grip band, while the free hand holds a fanned gold and lavender color-swatch card set. A loose pencil sketch sheet is clipped to the easel edge. Thin grey floor line, faint grey decorative circles only — NO opaque background, NO text, NO letter, NO border frame. Subtle Artistic RIASEC gold accent on swatches and stylus. Playful imaginative energy, full head-to-feet visible.
